title: Implement deterministic repository quality and security gates
description: Add strict C# formatting and analyzers, deterministic NuGet/tool inputs, repository-owned agent and Git hook gates, hardened CI, dependency/security scanning, coverage, mutation-test tooling, and release provenance. Bring first-party code to the enforced baseline without weakening existing behavior.
close_reason: Strict formatting, analyzers, dependency locks and audits, hooks, pinned CI, CodeQL, Dependabot, tool manifests, and a green canonical full gate are implemented.

title: Make the repository test gate deterministic
description: The pre-tooling baseline build succeeds, but solution-wide dotnet test runs project test hosts concurrently. Avalonia/global-state assemblies interfere, fixed localhost ports collide, and UI dispatcher tests fail nondeterministically. Define a deterministic test execution strategy and retain coverage/result collection without hiding real failures.
close_reason: The canonical gate now runs test projects sequentially with single-threaded xUnit configuration; repeated App-suite stress runs and the complete full gate pass.
